messages:
alex: Heads-up — starting a canary for model-v2 across tiers. Plan: PRO 10% exposure, STARTUP 2% exposure in us-west. Need to lock down routing + fallback semantics before rollout.

maya: +1. Clarify: if runtime triggers fallback (latency or quality), do we prefer a compatible v2 variant (quantized/smaller) or fall all the way back to v1?

ravi: My vote: keep fallbacks tier-scoped. PRO should try v2-quant -> v2-small -> v1. STARTUP should go straight to v1 to minimize cross-tier capacity impact.

sam: Ops risk: if PRO canary falls back into the shared/default pool we'll break isolation guarantees. We need a config flag to prevent cross-tier fallback.

alex: Proposal sketch for routing config: 
```
route_policy:
  rollout_id: "canary-model-v2-2026-03"
  exposure:
    PRO: 0.10
    STARTUP: 0.02
  fallback_order:
    PRO: ["v2-quant","v2-small","v1"]
    STARTUP: ["v1"]
  per_tier_isolation: true
```

maya: Nice. Telemetry requirement: every request should get tags: rollout_id, tier, exposure_bucket, fallback_reason. We need fallback_reason enum (latency, oom, quality_regression, capacity).

ravi: Also emit metrics: rollout.exposure.{tier}, rollout.fallback.count.{tier}.{reason}, fallback.latency.delta, fallback.quality.delta. Capture sampled route_decision_trace for postmortems.

casey: Console UX: expose an "exposure matrix" that shows per-tier % exposed + live fallback counts and a tiny streaming heatmap. Add a toggle: "prevent cross-tier fallback" so product can decide isolation strictness.

sam: Quota interplay: if PRO burst is exhausted, canary traffic must not silently spill into other pools. Options: queue, degrade, or fallback with a quota-consent check. We should default to degrade with an alert.

alex: Action items: 1) API: add rollout_scope/per_tier_exposure and fallback_order list. 2) Runtime: enforce per-tier_isolation flag before applying fallback; prefer same-variant fallbacks. 3) Telemetry: rollout tags + fallback_reason enum + sampled traces. 4) Console: exposure matrix + cross-tier toggle + alerting hooks.

maya: I'll open an API PR with the schema and example.
ravi: I'll add runtime checks and a gated simulation harness to run traffic mixes (10k qps) to validate.
casey: I'll wire a mock UI and a mock telemetry panel for the demo.
sam: I'll spec the alert runbook for cross-tier fallback and quota exhaustion.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by maya:pr/483 -> staging :rocket:

alex: Thanks all — sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to review PRs. :thumbsup:
